g.text: A state can pass to new carriers, be changed, and pass onward again.
Both written and ordinary-M founders complete the chain at both numerical resolutions.
Blocked communication prevents transfer; sham and no-cue rewriting retain M.
P11 protocol schematic. Cells, cues, contacts and schedules are supplied; no cell division or autonomous goal selection.
New stock and all stages use bounded integration clocks. Shared deterministic preparations are not population replicates.
